description: This interface defines supervision functionality for a specific Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection within the gateway service, extending a streaming supervision interface and providing a supervise method.

classes.name: SseConnectionSupervisor
classes.description: Interface for supervising a specific SSE connection within the gateway streaming infrastructure, extending StreamSupervisor and providing a supervise method.

methods.name: supervise
methods.description: Overrides the supervise method to handle supervision of a SupervisedStream, given a connection correlation ID and DittoHeaders.
